subject: English

source: Written for english/y5 lesson 100 (Year 5 spelling check: 30 words in sentences (teacher-written from the Year 5 patterns and the Year 5 and 6 statutory list; in the portal and printable))
intro: Lesson 100. Listen to each word in a sentence. Write the word.

blocks.answers: 1 comfortable; 2 horrible; 3 noticeable; 4 observant; 5 confident; 6 innocence; 7 suspenseful; 8 ancient; 9 official; 10 essential; 11 accommodate; 12 according; 13 aggressive; 14 amateur; 15 average; 16 bargain; 17 communicate; 18 community; 19 conscience; 20 curiosity; 21 definite; 22 desperate; 23 environment; 24 especially; 25 exaggerate; 26 familiar; 27 foreign; 28 guarantee; 29 immediately; 30 parliament

blocks.note: Teacher reads each word, then the sentence, then the word again: 1 comfortable: The chair was comfortable. 2 horrible: The weather was horrible. 3 noticeable: The change was noticeable. 4 observant: An observant pupil saw it. 5 confident: She felt confident. 6 innocence: He proved his innocence. 7 suspenseful: The story was suspenseful. 8 ancient: It was an ancient ship. 9 official: It was an official visit. 10 essential: Water is essential. 11 accommodate: The hotel can accommodate us. 12 according: According to the map, we are close. 13 aggressive: The dog was not aggressive. 14 amateur: He is an amateur painter. 15 average: The average score was high. 16 bargain: It was a bargain. 17 communicate: We communicate by email. 18 community: Our community is kind. 19 conscience: Listen to your conscience. 20 curiosity: Curiosity helps us learn. 21 definite: Is the date definite? 22 desperate: They were desperate for water. 23 environment: Protect the environment. 24 especially: I like fruit, especially mangoes. 25 exaggerate: Do not exaggerate. 26 familiar: The road looked familiar. 27 foreign: She speaks a foreign language. 28 guarantee: There is a guarantee. 29 immediately: Come immediately. 30 parliament: Parliament made a new law.
